version.approval_notes:
Folio is a bookmark manager over the browser's native bookmarks. It has no server, no account, and no analytics. No test account or login is needed. Install it, press Alt+S to save a page, and open the full page with Alt+Shift+F.

BUILD (the source zip is attached as the source code upload)
Requirements: Node 22 and pnpm.
  1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
  2. FOLIO_UPDATE_URL=https://folio.cinematicgenius007.com/updates.json pnpm zip:firefox
Output: .output/folio-<version>-firefox.zip, which is the submitted add-on. The same command also writes the sources zip. (FOLIO_UPDATE_URL only adds update_url to the manifest, for this self-distributed build.)
The extension is built with WXT (Vite) from TypeScript and React. The minified chunks in the package come from this build.

PERMISSIONS
- bookmarks: read and change the native bookmark tree. This is the core feature.
- activeTab: read the title and URL of the current page, only when the user clicks the toolbar icon or uses the shortcut, so it can be saved.
- unlimitedStorage: a rebuildable local search index, cached favicons, and an optional user-chosen background image can exceed the default quota.
- <all_urls> (host permission): used only to fetch each bookmarked site's favicon directly from that site, because Firefox has no favicon cache API for extensions. Requests carry no cookies and no referrer. Only public http and https hosts are contacted. localhost, private and link-local ranges (including IPv6 forms), .local and single-label hostnames are refused, and a redirect to a private address is discarded. Downloads are size-capped and time out after 6 seconds. No third-party service is used. There are no content scripts and no page access.

DATA
data_collection_permissions is "none". Nothing is sent to the developer or any third party. Tags, notes, settings and the search index stay in the browser's IndexedDB. The only network requests made by the extension are the direct favicon requests above. The update_url in the manifest is read by the browser's own updater, not by the extension.

INNERHTML WARNING
The validator reports two "Unsafe assignment to innerHTML" warnings in chunks/Favicon-*.js. They come from react-dom's own internals (its handling of dangerouslySetInnerHTML). Folio's source contains no innerHTML or dangerouslySetInnerHTML at all, which can be checked with: grep -rn "innerHTML" components lib entrypoints

NO REMOTE CODE
No code is loaded from the network, and there is no eval. All fonts are bundled.

Source code: https://github.com/CinematicGenius007/folio (MIT)
